name: workers-ai
description: Add a typed Workers AI binding boundary with validated structured output and deterministic fallback behavior.
config: Add an AI binding named AI to wrangler.jsonc.
Add a non-secret AI_MODEL variable containing a currently supported structured-output model.
Regenerate worker-configuration.d.ts after changing bindings or variables.
docs: Document the selected model, timeout, schema owner, validator, and deterministic fallback.
Keep application prompts and domain schemas in the adopting feature rather than in this kit.
notes: The generated Env type is the source of truth for AI and AI_MODEL.
JSON mode can still return invalid output, so the runtime validator is mandatory.
The mock implements the local runner seam instead of casting a partial object to the full generated binding type.
